claims.statement: Set tropical year three parts in ten thousand below Guo Shoujing
Judged Tycho's reduction excessive; fixed 365.242344201415 days
Petitioned citing ancient method to correct Rahu and Ketu names
Deliberated reply re-fixing Rahu-Ketu names and adding Purple Qi

translationRepairs: The angle between them is the refraction correction, though Tycho had no formula to compute it.
The angle between them is the refraction correction, but there was not yet a computational method.

s0018 says 然未有算術: only that no computational method yet existed, with no named agent; the idiomatic “though Tycho had no formula” invents Tycho as subject. The proposed replacement matches the Chinese and remains grammatical.
In Shou (fifth month, jianwu): mantises, shrikes, silent mockingbirds, deer shedding antlers, cicadas, pinellia — six pentads.
In Chunshou (fifth month, jianwu): mantises, shrikes, silent mockingbirds, deer shedding antlers, cicadas, pinellia — six pentads.
s0318 has 日躔鶉首; 鶉首 is the solar mansion Chunshou, and truncating to Shou drops 鶉. Chunshou restores the full mansion name consistently with neighboring full forms such as 大梁/Daliang.
Sun in Shou, as jianwu fifth month: mantises hatch, shrikes call, mockingbirds silent, deer antlers shed, cicadas chirp, pinellia grows — six pentads.
Sun in Chunshou, as jianwu fifth month: mantises hatch, shrikes call, mockingbirds silent, deer antlers shed, cicadas chirp, pinellia grows — six pentads.
The same unit’s 鶉首 is truncated to Shou in the literal; replacing with Chunshou corrects the mansion name without altering the rest of the rendering.
In Huo (sixth month, jianwei): warm winds, crickets indoors, hunting hawks, fireflies, humid heat, heavy rains — six pentads.
In Chunhuo (sixth month, jianwei): warm winds, crickets indoors, hunting hawks, fireflies, humid heat, heavy rains — six pentads.
s0319 has 日躔鶉火; 鶉火 is Chunhuo, and Huo alone omits 鶉. The proposed Chunhuo is accurate.
Sun in Huo, as jianwei sixth month: warm winds arrive, crickets in walls, hawks strike prey, rotten grass becomes fireflies, earth damp with heat, great rains — six pentads.
Sun in Chunhuo, as jianwei sixth month: warm winds arrive, crickets in walls, hawks strike prey, rotten grass becomes fireflies, earth damp with heat, great rains — six pentads.
Literal likewise reduces 鶉火 to Huo; Chunhuo restores the full mansion reading required by the Chinese.
In Wei (seventh month, jianshen): cool winds, white dew, autumn cicadas, hawks hunting, autumn austerity, grain harvest — six pentads.
In Chunwei (seventh month, jianshen): cool winds, white dew, autumn cicadas, hawks hunting, autumn austerity, grain harvest — six pentads.
s0320 has 日躔鶉尾; 鶉尾 is Chunwei, and Wei alone drops 鶉 and invites confusion with other Wei mansions. Chunwei is the correct full form.
Sun in Wei, as jianshen seventh month: cool winds, white dew falls, cold cicadas, hawks offer birds, heaven and earth grow austere, grain ripens — six pentads.
Sun in Chunwei, as jianshen seventh month: cool winds, white dew falls, cold cicadas, hawks offer birds, heaven and earth grow austere, grain ripens — six pentads.
Literal truncates 鶉尾 to Wei; restoring Chunwei matches the Chinese mansion name without other changes.
